issues: 列表行和顶栏全是灰色骨架块，停点行没有内容，咬合锁定的是一条空白
滚动模糊是各向同性 blur，封顶 24px 时整屏糊成一片灰雾

停点高亮靠 3px 墨色边框，其余行不退暗，标签 scale 从 0 弹出；没有导出时长常量
changes: 导出 BRAKE_RETICLE_LOCK_DURATION = 150；真实感 changelog 行（类型图标 / 标题 / 说明 / 版本 / 日期）+ 真实应用顶栏（Acme / Changelog / 头像）
急刹帧 f59、冲过头 30px、角标同帧起跳与 back(2.4) 咬合全部保留；滚动模糊改为纵向 SpeedBlur（v×0.15，封顶 32px）

柔光亮场 + 列表上下渐隐 + 颗粒
issuesEn: Rows and the top bar were grey skeleton blocks; the stop row was empty, so the reticle locked onto nothing
Scroll blur was isotropic and at its 24px cap turned the whole screen into grey fog
The four L corners were thick 8px ink brackets flying 620px in 9f with no trail, reading as dropped frames
The stop highlight was a 3px ink border, other rows never dimmed, the tag scaled from 0, and there was no duration constant
changesEn: Exported BRAKE_RETICLE_LOCK_DURATION = 150; realistic changelog rows (type icon, title, description, version, date) and a real app top bar (Acme / Changelog / avatar)
Brake frame f59, the 30px overshoot, same-frame corner launch and back(2.4) lock are all kept; scroll blur is now a vertical SpeedBlur (v×0.15, capped at 32px)
Corners are 6px round-capped accent L brackets with directional motion blur from their own velocity while flying, clear on lock
Stop row v2.41 Realtime collaboration gets an accent icon, 2px accent ring and lift shadow while other rows dim to 0.38 over 12f; the Just shipped tag pops 0.6→1 with back easing and a green dot
Soft-lit light backdrop, top and bottom list fades and grain
